name: OBS Recording (Target Resolution Engine)
description: Design doc section 12's worked example, applied to OBS's Start/Stop Recording button: ClickTarget tries the native UI Automation/AT-SPI element query first (fast, exact), falls back to OCR text if the native lookup fails (a UI refresh moved/renamed the control), and falls back to a known-good coordinate as the last resort — the same 'UI Automation FAIL -> Accessibility FAIL -> OCR SUCCESS' chain section 12 diagrams. Unlike obs-recording-ocr.json (which always uses OCR), this keeps the fast native path as the default and only pays OCR's cost when it's actually needed.
